lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns; the anterior section shows a higher density of smaller, closely packed clusters, transitioning to larger, more isolated nodes toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like lattice structure across the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance pixels above to darker, shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small, high-intensity spots that differ in scale and arrangement from the more structured patterning on the lateral flank.
